description: Source code for the STMicroelectronics IIS2DH 3-axis accelerometer driver in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, configuration, data fetching, and conversion functions.

methods.name: iis2dh_set_fs_raw
methods.description: Sets the full scale raw value and updates internal gain.

methods.name: iis2dh_set_range
methods.description: Configures the accelerometer's full scale range.

methods.name: iis2dh_set_odr
methods.description: Sets the output data rate for the accelerometer.

methods.name: iis2dh_convert
methods.description: Converts raw sensor data to m/s^2 using gain.

methods.name: iis2dh_channel_get_acc
methods.description: Retrieves acceleration data for specified channel.

methods.name: iis2dh_channel_get
methods.description: Gets sensor data for specified channel.

methods.name: iis2dh_config
methods.description: Configures sensor attributes like range and sampling frequency.

methods.name: iis2dh_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes for specific channels.

methods.name: iis2dh_init
methods.description: Initializes the accelerometer device, checks ID, sets default configs.
